messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: This is up to a maximum first dose of 50 mg.
Doses above 2 mg/kg have not been studied.
Doses above 200 mg a day have not been studied.
Extended-release metoprolol has not been studied in children under 6 years.
Dose adjustments:
Liver problems.
Start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly.
Kidney problems.
No dose reduction is needed.
Older adults.
A low starting dose is generally used.
This is because liver, kidney, and heart function are more often reduced.
Other medicines are more often involved.
Switching between forms.
When changing from immediate-release to extended-release metoprolol, the same total daily dose is used.
Triplet: ["Metoprolol", "has dose adjustment reason", "other medicines are more often involved"]

The relation 'has dose adjustment reason' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires dose adjustments due to the reason specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose limitation': The subject drug has a restriction on the dose specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'has strength': The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
